verdict.rationale: Cake ships a few fixed, built-in background automations: the vesting engine automates cliffs, schedules, milestones and pauses, it can automatically notify your registered agent of share issuances, transfers and conversions, and it offers automated board sign-off and e-signing flows. Nothing shows a user-configurable automation or agent layer, and the MCP integration is explicitly read-only Q&A rather than autonomous action. Missing for 10: a user-defined automation/workflow builder, triggers and scheduling, agent-driven write actions that run unattended, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
